name: order-webhook-intake
description: Turns order webhooks from your store or checkout into Order and Customer records, and flags high-value or risky orders for a person to check.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Your store or checkout sends an order to a webhook URL

howItWorks.label: Does
howItWorks.text: Creates or updates the order and its customer, matched by order number and email

howItWorks.label: Flags
howItWorks.text: High-value orders and orders with fraud warning signs

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve each set of record changes

plugins.reason: Posts flagged orders to a channel so someone checks them quickly

data.description: The order's number or id in the source system, used to avoid duplicates
The order's payment or fulfilment status
The order's line items (product, SKU, quantity, price)
The link from the order to its customer
The customer's email, used to find an existing customer
A field to mark an order for review, with a reason

parameters.label: High-value order amount
parameters.description: Flag orders whose total is at or above this, in the store's currency

parameters.label: Slack channel for flagged orders
parameters.description: Optional; leave empty to only flag the order record

parameters.label: Update existing customers
parameters.description: Fill in missing customer details (name, phone, address) from new orders
